resources.string: Tapping an object name opens the Observatory without pausing time.
Main-view buttons and status links keep their own actions instead of triggering pause.
Cleaner main logo, with version information kept in Info & credits.
Reference grid enabled by default at 50 percent opacity across all views.
Captures inherit grid settings; preview changes stay separate from the main view.
Saved grid choices, Locations, Scenes and celestial selections are preserved.
